in_marathi.name: Nadish
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the mind, consciousness
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nadish हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nadish is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'nadi', meaning 'river' or 'current'. It is believed to represent the lord of the mind or consciousness. The name is also associated with the Nadis, or energy channels, in the human body.
